args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; Import-Module /opt/tools/parts/powershell/modules/PSScriptAnalyzer/PSScriptAnalyzer.psd1; $settings = @{}; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath '.powershell-formatter.psd1') { $settings.Settings = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath '.powershell-formatter.psd1').Path }; foreach ($file in $args) { $text = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText((Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $file).Path); $formatted = Invoke-Formatter -ScriptDefinition $text @settings; if ($formatted -ne $text) { $file } }

governed.config: the formatter reads the project's .powershell-formatter.psd1 settings file, else the module's default code-formatting preset: the project decides the layout

suppressions.description: not honored: the formatter has no in-code suppression

en.label: PSScriptAnalyzer formatter (PowerShell)
en.purpose: Checks that PowerShell files already have the layout the PSScriptAnalyzer formatter would give them: indentation, braces, spacing and casing.
en.limitation: It only reports the files the formatter would change and never rewrites them; it reads the project's .powershell-formatter.psd1 when there is one, else the default preset.
en.needs: Nothing beyond the tools image (PowerShell and the module are in it): no network and no project dependencies.

pt-BR.label: Formatador PSScriptAnalyzer (PowerShell)
pt-BR.purpose: Confere se os arquivos PowerShell já têm o layout que o formatador do PSScriptAnalyzer daria: indentação, chaves, espaçamento e maiúsculas.
pt-BR.limitation: Só informa os arquivos que o formatador mudaria e nunca os reescreve; lê o .powershell-formatter.psd1 do projeto quando existe, senão o preset padrão.
pt-BR.needs: Nada além da imagem de ferramentas (o PowerShell e o módulo já estão nela): sem rede e sem as dependências do projeto.
